name: Mountain Camp
beschreibung: The Mountain Camp in Jerzens (Pitztal) is situated at around 1,200 metres above sea level and is surrounded by alpine meadows and forests. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents as well as sanitary facilities with showers and WCs. A common room and a laundry room complete the amenities. For meals, there is a bread roll service and a small restaurant with regional dishes. The quiet atmosphere on the edge of the village makes the site suitable for families and nature lovers. Hiking trails start directly at the site, and the valley station of the Hochzeiger-Bergbahnen is within walking distance.
